findings.qualification: The outer Intent/Vocabulary descriptions do carry V4_EXPERIMENTAL_STATEMENT. The finding is the contradictory nested affirmative claims, not a demand that every field repeat the constant. These are descriptions in the exported document schema RH-007 explicitly governs; the CLI manifest emits operation input schemas, so no claim is made that these nested descriptions appear in the shipped CLI manifest. Unique-id validation is real and is not disputed.

observations.reason: A dangling symspec.config.json directory entry is treated as absent by fs.exists.
